releaseNotes: v1.9.7: A disabled model is now skipped at runtime instead of only hidden from the listing — combos strip it from the flattened leaf list and from every strategy (fallback, round-robin, sticky, capacity, fusion), the model picker drops it from custom nodes, and a combo card holding a disabled model fades out. Also gates /debug/pprof behind admin auth and sets http.Server connection limits (Slowloris).
